question: ____________ founded Satyashodhak Samaj, which campaigned against idolatry and the caste system.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotirao Govindrao Phule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Satyashodhak Samaj**

 
 
• Satyashodhak Samaj was founded by Jyotirao Phule in 1873 in Pune. 
 
• Jyotirao Govindrao Phule was an Indian social activist, thinker, anti-caste social reformer and writer from Maharashtra.
